item.title: Birthday fireworks spark Henrico house fire; family of 5 displaced
item.description: A Henrico family of five was displaced after birthday fireworks ignited a trash can and spread to their home on Cloverfield Court. No one was injured.

item.title: Loyola Chicago beats Richmond 69-66
item.description: Miles Rubin's 19 points helped Loyola Chicago defeat Richmond 69-66 on Saturday. Rubin also contributed five rebounds for the Ramblers (7-22, 3-13 Atlantic 10 Conference).

item.title: VCU wins 82-63 against Fordham
item.description: Led by Jadrian Tracey's 15 points, the VCU Rams defeated the Fordham Rams 82-63. Dejour Reaves finished with 22 points and eight assists for Fordham.
